description.en: How to handle files with the same name.

description.en: SHA-1 hash value of the file.

description.zh: 父文件ID。可通过[ListCdsFiles](~~2247622~~)接口的返回参数`FileId`获取。
description.en: Parent file ID. Get this from the `FileId` parameter returned by the [ListCdsFiles](~~2247622~~) API.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: Region ID. Call [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) to list regions supported by WUYING Workspace.

title.zh: 创建文件夹或创建文件上传任务
title.en: Create a Folder or Create a File Upload Job

descriptions.zh: 调用本接口可以直接在企业网盘中创建文件夹。如需上传文件，也可以调用本接口来获取上传链接，然后配合[CompleteCdsFile](~~2247620~~)接口完成文件上传。
descriptions.en: Call this API to create a folder directly in the enterprise cloud disk. To upload a file, call this API to obtain an upload URL. Then use that URL with the [CompleteCdsFile](~~2247620~~) API to complete the upload.
